scope: Bounded CPU numerical prototype only, no GPU or physical qualification.
protocol: Solve reduced natural map R(y)+lambda*(y-seed)=0 with fixed seed per arm, lambda = 1, .1, .01, .001, .0001, .00001, .000001, 0. At most 16 Newton solves each stage, eight Armijo1e-4 trial sizes; dense least-squares rcond1e-12. Stage max normalized augmented residual <=1e-10. Cold and captured-capped seeds; prior stage solution starts next. No parameter retries, no barrier, no altered domains or physical Gamma. Temporary proximal term is numerical continuation only; acceptance requires reaching lambda0 and original full natural/feasibility <=1e-8, primal agreement<=1e-9 and reconstructed per-row wave velocity/cache <=1e-5. Preserve a failed stage even if another state happens to have smaller original residual. This is float64 reference algorithm work, not GPU qualification.
